Don't do it!
]
I had tried valium, xanax and ambien many times over the years.  I would buy it in mexico and never abused it until just recently.  I have done a lot of different drugs and I have had some pretty major side effects but I feel that high doses of xanax + alcohol has been the most dangerous for me.  I have abused on two occasions and I hope that I am not dumb enough to do it a 3rd time.  First,  I get very bad black outs.  After one episode,  I had placed a chair in the bathroom and I had also brought a small toaster into my bedroom.  I have no idea why or what I did with either one.  I have to admit that the xanax and alcohol feels good but I lose all rational thought and do things like drive impaired which I would never do with just alcohol in my system.  The last episode I was so very impaired and knew it but there was no fear or worry that it was wrong to be driving in that state.  I am so glad that did not get into an accident or get arrested.  Any cop that would have watched me drive for a few seconds probably would have known. Once I run out and have to come down and got panic attacks and very depressed.  These are things that I normally do not have issues with.  The combo is just to strong and have never felt so out of of control.  I just hope that I am not dumb enough to repeat the mistake again.
